_comment: Authored source content for the Groups game. Original work: every
category and word list here was written for this app. Nothing is
Format. Each puzzle has exactly four categories; each category has a
'tag' (machine key), a 'name' (what the player is shown), a
'difficulty' 0-3 (0 most obvious, used once each per puzzle), and a
'words' map of WORD -> extra plausible tags.
The extra-tag list is the ambiguity guard. tool/gen_groups_bank.dart
adds each word's own category tag automatically, then refuses any
puzzle where a word's tags touch a second category in that same
puzzle. Declare a sense whenever a word could honestly be filed
somewhere else - that is what makes the check worth running.
